title: Why Officely Beats Envoy for Slack-Based Desk Booking
summary: Compare Officely and Envoy for Slack-based desk booking, including workflows, workplace visibility, pricing models, and setup.
body_markdown:
Envoy is a well-known workplace platform with web, mobile, and Slack experiences. Its Slack app can register onsite days, book or cancel desks, check into rooms, send visitor and delivery notifications, and update Slack location status[\[1\]](https://envoy.com/integrations/slack) . Officely takes a more focused approach: its everyday attendance and booking experience was designed around Slack from day one.


This is where Officely shines. Built from the ground up for Slack, Officely eliminates the friction that causes employees to abandon "yet another app." It’s no wonder so many companies that run on Slack are now searching for **Envoy alternatives** that can deliver an experience their teams will actually embrace.


## How Envoy and Officely Differ in Slack


Envoy’s Slack integration is substantive, not notification-only. The key buying question is whether your team wants Slack access to a broad, modular workplace platform or a more focused office-attendance and resource-booking workflow centered in Slack.


### Home Tabs and Slash Commands


Envoy supports both an app Home tab and slash commands. Employees can view schedules and change desks from the Home tab, or use commands such as` /envoy-desk` ,` /envoy-in` , and` /envoy-schedule`[\[2\]](https://envoy.help/en/articles/7947825-using-slack-with-envoy) . Officely emphasizes guided, visual booking flows rather than requiring commands for common actions.


### Breadth Versus Focus


Envoy combines Slack with web, mobile, maps, calendars, visitor management, emergency communications, deliveries, and other modules. That breadth can suit organizations consolidating several workplace systems. Officely is the more focused choice for teams primarily coordinating attendance and bookings in Slack or Microsoft Teams.


### Missing the "Why": A Lack of Social Context


Envoy can share onsite status in Slack and offers coworker schedules in parts of its Workplace experience. Officely puts "Who’s In" visibility at the center of its Slack workflow, making teammate plans prominent while employees decide when and where to book.


## The Officely Advantage: A Truly Native Slack Experience


Officely was built on a simple but powerful idea: your office management tool should live where your team already works. We designed Officely specifically for hybrid companies that use Slack as their digital headquarters.


### Live and Work Directly in Slack


With Officely, everything happens 100% inside Slack. There are no new apps to download, no separate logins to remember, and no new interfaces to learn. Booking a desk, checking who's in, and managing office days feels like a natural part of the Slack workflow. This design reduces the number of separate employee workflows needed for office coordination.


### Smart Features Designed Around Attendance


Officely goes beyond simple booking. Our "Who's In" feature gives everyone visibility into office plans, encouraging teammates to come in on the same days. Smart recommendations even suggest the best days for you to go in based on when your colleagues will be there.


We also make it easy to foster community by automatically starting a daily chat for everyone who's in the office. These features transform the office from just a place to work into a destination for collaboration and connection.


### Simplicity and Fair Pricing


Officely was purpose-built for hybrid work and offers month-to-month options. Envoy publishes Reservations pricing at $5 per bookable resource per month, billed annually, excluding its platform fee[\[3\]](https://envoy.com/pricing) . Buyers should compare the total package they need rather than treating Envoy as per-user desk-booking software.


## Head-to-Head: Officely vs. Envoy for Slack Users


When you put the two side-by-side for a team that runs on Slack, the difference is clear.

## The Bottom Line: Choose the Tool Your Team Will Actually Use


At the end of the day, even a feature-rich platform underperforms if employees find it difficult to use. Compare how each option fits your team’s daily workflow, which actions are available in Slack, and when employees need its web or mobile experience. As experts note, among the many desk booking software options, the user experience is what truly determines success[\[4\]](https://www.albertodirisio.com/desk-booking-software) .


Officely’s Slack-centered design reduces the number of new workflows employees need to learn and keeps booking, attendance visibility, and coordination together.
